title: The Inverted Tower
text: A tower hangs point-down from nothing, its spire aimed at the ground like a spear. Its windows glow. Its door, at the bottom that is really its top, stands open. Somewhere inside, someone is singing upside down.

options.label: Climb up into the hanging tower to see who sings inside.

outcomes.text: Inside is a library turned on its head; the books can still be read if you hang by your knees.
It falls upward with you inside, and keeps falling. Nobody is sure it ever stops.

options.label: The sharpest looks in from below before anyone climbs.

outcomes.text: Someone upside down looks back at them. With a little wave, it points the way onward.

options.label: Do not go up; a tower that hangs from nothing is not to be trusted.

outcomes.text: The tower turns, slowly, to watch you go.
